content.text: This is a bounded transport/audit calibration with real models, not a performance benchmark. Do not read or write files, browse, or use shell. Use only native collaboration spawn/wait plus collaboration_exchange. Spawn exactly one peer named peer, fork_turns=none, same gpt-6.1-sol medium. Give peer these instructions: "You are peer in a 3-message audit probe. Do not spawn. You inherit collaboration_exchange. First call it with operation receive,target root,reply_to empty,body empty. After receiving proposal m1, critically assess whether a transport delivery receipt proves task completion; send ONE short evidence-oriented challenge with operation send_wait,target root,reply_to m1. After response m3 arrives, output PEER_FINAL with whether the response addresses your challenge and the received m3 body_sha256, and finish. No other tools except collaboration_exchange." After spawning, call collaboration_exchange with operation send_wait,target peer,reply_to empty and a proposal asking whether a delivery receipt is sufficient to display task completed, and what evidence would be needed. After challenge m2, send one revised response via operation send,target peer,reply_to m2. Then wait for peer completion and output ROOT_FINAL. Do not use native send_message/followup_task for message bodies. Keep each body below 120 words. No further work.
